families.name: Long prompt (10+ words)
families.catches: Full-sentence prompts typed or passed through by AI assistants and AI Mode. The strongest single signal.

families.name: Conversational length (7-9 words)
families.catches: Queries longer than classic keywords but shorter than full prompts.

families.name: Question opener
families.catches: Queries that start like a question to an assistant: what, how, why, can, should, is...

families.name: Instruction / request
families.regex: (?i)^(give|show|tell|help|explain|list|compare|recommend|suggest|find|create|write|generate|make|summarise|summarize|describe|plan|calculate|teach|guide|walk|act|pretend|please|i need|i want|im looking|i'm looking|i am looking|looking for|can you|could you)\b
families.catches: Commands written for an AI: give me, explain, compare, list, write, help me, I need, I'm looking for...

families.name: First-person context
families.catches: Personal situations people describe to an AI: my garage, I have, we need, our team... ('me' is left out on purpose: it would catch every 'near me' search).

families.name: Comparison
families.regex: (?i)\b(vs|versus|compare|compared|comparison|alternative|alternatives|difference between|differences between|better than|pros and cons|which is better)\b
families.catches: X vs Y, alternatives, differences, pros and cons, which is better.

families.name: Recommendation / best-of
families.regex: (?i)\b(best|top \d+|top rated|recommend|recommended|most reliable|most popular|most affordable|cheapest|worth it|should i (buy|use|choose|get|hire|go with))\b
families.catches: Best, top 10, recommended, worth it, should I buy/hire - the queries AI answers with shortlists of brands.

families.name: Constraints & specifics
families.regex: (?i)\b(for beginners|for a small|for small|for my|for someone|step by step|under \$?\d+|less than|on a budget|without|checklist|template|example|examples|in 20\d\d|for 20\d\d)\b
families.catches: Extra conditions people add when they expect a tailored answer: for beginners, under $500, step by step, without, checklist.

families.name: How / why / is-it reasoning
families.regex: (?i)\b(how (to|do|does|can|long|much|many|often)|why (is|do|does|are|would)|what (is|are|does|happens|should)|is it (safe|worth|possible|legal|true|normal|ok|okay|better)|does it|can i|should i|do i need)\b
families.catches: Explanation and decision questions anywhere in the query: how long, why does, is it worth, do I need, can I.

families.name: AI tool mention / leaked prompt
families.catches: Queries naming an AI tool, or URL-prefixed prompts (including 'https //' without the colon) like the ChatGPT queries reported leaking into GSC in late 2025.

families.name: Follow-up / context-less prompt
families.regex: (?i)(^(how about|what about|and what|show (me )?(photos|pics|pictures|images|designs|examples?|an example)|show (photos|pics|pictures|images)|can (you|i) (see|show)|give (me )?(images|pics|photos|examples)|which (is|one|more)|are they|is it|is that|what if|why does it|how much (would|approximately|to get)|whats? the (cheapest|cost|best))\b|\?$)
families.catches: AI Mode follow-ups typed mid-conversation, often with no topic word at all: show me photos, which is cheaper?, how about in brisbane, are they slippery, give images of each. Also any query ending in '?'.

families.name: Search operators (AI agents & tools)
families.catches: Queries using site:, intitle:, inurl:, -site: exclusions or a quoted phrase - typed by AI agents and research tools, not people. Reported separately and kept out of the content plan.
